As the 3rd fastest-growing B2B AI start-up worldwide, we're displacing legacy platforms like Zendesk at scale — across industries, regions, and thousands of companies worldwide.

The work ahead is ambitious. The opportunity is rare. We take a deliberate approach to growth: product-led, capital-efficient, and highly focused.

If you want to build the customer support platform for the AI era, we're looking for top talent to join us.

**About the Role**

As a Software Developer at Botpress, you'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive the future of conversational AI. As part of the engineering team, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain scalable applications that enhance the capabilities of our AI agent platform. You'll use your technical expertise to solve complex problems while ensuring the highest standards of code quality and performance.

* Design, develop, test, and deploy customer-impacting features
* Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to define and implement new features

#### **Why should you consider joining Auvik?**

* **You want to work at a company that is building impactful, relevant technology.** Auvik's network management software helps IT teams by automating time-consuming tasks, streamlining operations, and mitigating risk. It's more important than ever to be able to remotely monitor and manage network infrastructure, and with Auvik, IT professionals have that essential visibility and control.

* **You want to work with a leadership team who are transparent and trustworthy.** Our senior leaders have a vision for Auvik. They are experienced, knowledgeable, approachable, and consistently working hard to drive success, both for the company and the team of people who make it happen.

* **You want to work with a product customers love.** People rave about what we've built. Our customers are smart, aspirational, and highly technical. It pays to get the details right.

* **You want regular opportunities for learning and growth.** With ongoing feedback from leadership, you'll find that Auvik encourages you to be your very best. Our onboarding process is thorough and informative because we want to make sure you're prepared to have a great work experience. We also have programs designed to help you take the next steps you want for your career.

* **You want the flexibility to manage your work, your way.** We're a fully distributed team and we're prepared to continue to support working from home (or the space you choose!). We trust you to get the job done where you feel most comfortable and effective.

  

**What's this role about?**

As a software engineer at Auvik, you'll be part of an agile team of coders, developing a network management service that monitors millions of devices, while solving big challenges for our customers. Drawing on your love of developing creative solutions, your can-do attitude, and your drive to do great work, you'll help Auvik continue to build software our customers can rely on.

**What will I be doing?**

The industry is shifting towards cloud based systems and distributed work environments. We need senior software developers like yourself to level up on our product offerings. In this role, you will:

* Focus on designing architectures for microservices that are consistent, scalable, high quality and tolerant to faults and failures.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes orchestration.
* Design and implement protocols for communication in a highly scalable, distributed system.
* Develop reliable and performant code for our collector deployed at tens of thousands of customer sites.
* Develop tooling using information from Netflow, Syslog, and other networking standards.
* Help expand the depth and breadth of our solution based on your deep knowledge of networking devices and protocols.
* Collaborate with engineering and product management to deliver software components to meet the needs of our customers.
* Apply AI-enabled techniques to solve complex engineering problems, using intelligent tooling, automation, and data-informed debugging to build scalable systems, improve reliability, and accelerate delivery across the stack.

**What are we looking for?**

* Proven experience developing quality code and architectures preferably using or Golang or Javascript).
* Background in designing and developing microservices.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, preferably AWS.
* Adept in building reliable, highly available, and scalable software on top of the Kafka streaming platform.
* Proficiency in agile methodologies such as scrum.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD pipeline to test and deploy.
* Passion for mentoring and guiding junior and intermediate team members.
* Enthusiasm towards researching new technologies and making recommendations based on experiences and findings.
* Accountability towards following processes and making suggestions for improvements.
* Desire to collaboratively create elegant, scalable, modern, code that evolves our products.
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) to work collaboratively with the immediate team and the larger organization.

**We're actively hiring for this role and looking to bring someone great onto the team as soon as possible.**  
  
**About Auvik**

Auvik delivers cloud-based network management software that gives IT teams instant visibility and control over their infrastructure — whether on-site, remote, or dispersed across global networks. Our platform automates network discovery, mapping, monitoring, configuration backups, traffic analysis and alerting, so IT professionals and MSPs can manage complex, multi-site environments with ease.

We're focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you're excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to make any accommodations you may need throughout the interview process as well.

Auvik is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law.

At Auvik, our hiring process is designed to be personal, transparent, and human-led. Our Talent Acquisition Partners review all resumes, connect with candidates whose skills and experience aligns with the role, and stay in communication with you throughout your journey. If our interests align, you'll meet with a hiring manager, as well as additional members of the hiring team in follow-up conversations. All of your interviews will take place via Zoom.

Before meeting with a hiring manager, we also ask candidates to complete a 5-minute Predictive Index (PI) assessment. This helps us understand and match your strengths and work preferences with roles that will set you up for success.

* Design, refine, and iterate on rubrics and evaluation criteria for preference data
* Review and label data with a high bar for quality, catching subtle issues others might miss
* Build and maintain pipelines/infra that support data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows

* Demonstrated high-taste judgment — able to articulate why something is good, not just that it is.

* Work in a fully remote environment.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

* **Availability:** 40 hours/week preferred, with a minimum 6-hour overlap with Pacific Time. If you're unable to commit to 40 hours, please share your available hours and overlap window
* **Employment Type:** Independent contractor (does not include medical or paid leave benefits
* **Duration:** 3 months, with an expected start date as soon as possible

**Evaluation Process (approximately 30 mins):**

* One round of interview (30 mins of technical & cultural discussion)

LogiSense is looking for a Software Developer to help build and enhance our usage-based billing platform. You’ll bring strong C#, .NET, and Microsoft SQL Server skills, along with experience applying other technologies to solve problems. AI tools are part of your everyday development workflow, and you know how to validate their results.

You’ll work within a cross-functional sprint team and across the wider organization to turn customer and business needs into reliable improvements to the LogiSense Billing platform.

At LogiSense, we believe billing should be simple and transparent. Your work will turn customer and business needs into platform features that support that mission.

**Why Join LogiSense?**

* Remote-first culture with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
* A people-first environment that values integrity, balance, accountability, and innovation
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and funded learning and development

opportunities

* Ownership of complex features from design through delivery, with room to exercise your technical judgment
* Opportunities to apply your broader technical skills and AI-assisted development practices to real customer and business problems
* A chance to strengthen the team through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and improvements to how we build software

**The Role**

As a Software Developer at LogiSense, you’ll own complex features spanning multiple application components, from design through delivery.You’ll help clarify requirements, make well-reasoned technical decisions, and work with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address testing and regression risks. You’ll organize and prioritize your work with minimal supervision, provide realistic estimates, and raise risks early. You’ll know when to work through a problem independently and when to involve others. Through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing, you’ll help colleagues grow while contributing improvements to shared code and development practices.

At LogiSense, we live by three core values: Be good. Seek balance. Get paid. They guide everything we

do - and we hope they resonate with you too.

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**

* Strong experience developing enterprise applications with C# and .NET, plus experience applying other technologies to solve problems.
* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, T-SQL, and query optimization.
* Experience with at least one of Node.js or a modern UI framework.
* Practical experience incorporating AI tools into your everyday development workflow, understanding their limitations, validating their results, and sharing effective practices.
* Experience designing, implementing, and integrating with RESTful APIs.
* The ability to own complex features across multiple application components, from design through delivery, with minimal supervision.
* The ability to break down requirements into development tasks, identify dependencies, provide realistic estimates, and communicate risks early.
* Sound judgment in software design decisions and technical tradeoffs, including knowing when to involve others.
* A systematic approach to debugging, performance profiling, and optimization.
* Experience implementing automated unit and functional tests, and working with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address integration and regression risks.
* The ability to work with Product and other stakeholders to understand user needs and clarify requirements, and communicate technical decisions through documentation, walkthroughs, and discussions.
* The ability to develop a broad understanding of the LogiSense Billing platform and deep expertise in the components you support.
* The ability to mentor teammates through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* A commitment to supporting and improving the reliability of the software you deliver, in collaboration with IT and Support.
* Initiative to improve shared code, address technical debt, and strengthen development practices.

Strongly Preferred:

* Experience building, deploying, or supporting applications on AWS or another cloud platform.
* Experience working within Scrum or another Agile development process.

**Find Your Balance With Us**

Flexible Work, Built Around You

* Remote-first work within Canada, with flexibility and collaboration built into how we work
* A culture of trust and autonomy where your results matter more than where you sit

Well-Being & Growth

* Generous paid time off, holidays, and a company-wide holiday shutdown
* Dedicated time and funding for personal learning, certifications, and professional development
* A collaborative and respectful environment where you can grow - and help others grow too
* Opportunities to take on challenging work that expands your skill set and impact

**Get Paid What You're Worth**

Compensation & Benefits

* Annual base salary range of CAD $100,000 - $120,000, plus annual bonus potential of up to 10% of base salary with RRSP matching
* A comprehensive benefits package covering dental, vision, prescription, and extended healthcare that begins on day one
* Paid vacation and additional company holidays

* Access to stock options and equity for long-term, high-impact contributors
* Team events, company swag, and a culture that celebrates people, passion, and progress

jobs.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Information**
  
Job Requisition ID: 88284
  
Ministry: Technology and Innovation
  
Location: Edmonton
  
Full or Part-Time: Full-Time
  
Hours of Work: 36.25 hours per week
  
Permanent/Temporary/Wage: Permanent
  
Scope: Open Competition
  
Closing Date: October 13, 2026
  
Classification: Systems Analyst 1
  
Salary: $2,533.72 to $3,799.96 bi-weekly ($66,130 - $99,178/year)

  

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

  

Technology and Innovation is responsible for making innovation and technology the driving force behind Alberta’s economic growth and diversification.

  

The Digital Design and Delivery (DDD) division is the Government of Alberta’s centre of digital delivery. It partners with ministries to design simpler, faster, and better services; build capability and confidence in modern digital practices; and assure service quality and value through standards and controls. Multidisciplinary product teams are assigned priority GoA projects and employ an agile, product-oriented approach in providing solutions for ministry partners.

  

Within DDD, the Software Delivery Branch provides architectural leadership, CloudOps, DevOps practices, quality engineering, and software delivery excellence across product and platform teams. The Digital Architect plays a key role in shaping how digital solutions are designed, evolved, and governed, balancing innovation with reliability, security, and public sector responsibility.

**Role Responsibilities**
-------------------------

The Software Delivery branch is looking for six (6) Junior Full Stack Developers (FSD). Reporting to the Director, Software Development, this role supports the team in the design and implementation of software with a focus on iterative, continuous development, where requirements and solutions evolve through collaboration between cross-functional teams and users.

  

This role explicitly requires AI capability, creating systems with AI as a co-developer. So, we are seeking developers who can build, integrate, and optimize AI-driven solutions in addition to traditional front-end and back-end development.

  

The responsibilities of this role include:

* Develop and maintain front-end and back-end solutions, including AI-enabled features and digital services.
* Collaborate with agile teams, stakeholders, and users to design, build, and improve digital products.
* Contribute to backlog planning, effort estimation, and the delivery of high-quality software features.
* Apply development best practices, including testing, code reviews, CI/CD automation, and source control.
* Research emerging technologies and AI tools to identify opportunities for innovation and service improvement.
* Provide technical support and recommendations while communicating solutions effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  

To be successful in this position, you will demonstrate:

* Ability to self-learn a variety of software tools.
* Ability to keep up with industry standards and new tools or resources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  

The Job Description is provided for Further details on this position

**APS Competencies**
--------------------

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

  

* **Builds Collaborative Environment**: Engages diverse stakeholders and fosters collaboration through shared resources and inclusive dialogue. Resolves conflict through facilitation and coaching while valuing different perspectives to achieve outcomes.
* **Creative Problem Solving:** Uses diverse approaches to analyze problems and generate solutions. Encourages collaboration and brings the right people together to resolve issues.
* **Agility:** Adapts quickly to changing priorities and incorporates improvements into work. Stays composed under pressure and helps others adjust to change.
* **Develop Self and Others:** Builds individual and team capability through learning and development. Promotes shared learning and supports personal development planning.
* **Systems Thinking:** Considers broader trends, risks, and context when making decisions. Aligns actions with organizational goals and addresses barriers to progress.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Requirements:**

* A related two-year diploma in computer technology or a related discipline from a recognized post-secondary institution.
* Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including secure, scalable application development, testing, CI/CD, DevOps, monitoring, source control, code reviews, and the full software development lifecycle.).
* A cover letter clearly demonstrating relevant skills and competencies tailored to this position.
  

**Equivalencies:**

* A related one-year certificate from a recognized post-secondary institution and one (1) year of related experience.
  

**Assets:**

* Experience designing, developing, and supporting modern full-stack applications using front-end technologies, back-end services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, databases, and scalable enterprise architectures.
* Experience developing, integrating, and supporting AI-powered applications using modern frameworks, APIs, cloud services, automation platforms, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of AI software engineering practices, including responsible AI principles, governance requirements, secure development, deployment, monitoring, API integration, and enterprise technology standards.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation technologies to solve business problems, improve efficiency and user experience, and collaborate effectively wi

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer - Golang & Nodejs
jobs.description:
CGI is seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our team and help design, build, and evolve production-grade backend systems and cloud-native platforms. This role is ideal for a senior software professional with deep expertise in Go, strong Node.js development experience, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud services, CI/CD, and engineering automation. As a key member of the engineering team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, deployment, and operational excellence of scalable backend services while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions. Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who brings sound engineering judgment, challenges assumptions constructively, and helps elevate team decision-making through thoughtful collaboration and technical leadership. This is a full-time permanent opportunity.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and distributed systems using Go.
* Contribute to full-stack application development using Node.js and React.
* Design and implement secure, reliable REST APIs and backend services.
* Build, maintain, and optimize cloud-native solutions using AWS services and modern cloud engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and engineering tooling.
* Create and maintain Bash scripts and automation solutions to improve development and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality software solutions.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and architectural improvements early in the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members, promote engineering best practices, and contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Significant professional experience developing enterprise backend or platform solutions.
* Strong hands-on experience developing production-grade backend services using Go.
* Experience with full-stack or backend development using Node.js.
* Experience developing modern web applications using React.
* Strong understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development.
* Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Strong scripting experience using Bash or similar scripting languages.
* Experience designing and developing REST APIs and scalable distributed systems.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to communicate technical trade-offs effectively, work independently, and contribute positively to technical discussions and decision-making.

  
Assets  
The following qualifications would be considered assets:  

* Experience with distributed systems, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience working with both legacy and modern cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience improving software reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
* Experience mentoring software developers and providing technical leadership.
* Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries.

  
CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000-$145,000 CAD. This role is an existing vacancy.  
  
#LI-HG

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  
  
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  
  
At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  
  
To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

jobs.description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content — they're places where communities build.

Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

As a Software Developer, you will help build the agentic harness that turns intent into working games and the loop that lets an agent write, run, evaluate, and repair its own work.

This is a hybrid role, onsite three days a week, in Redwood City, Montreal, or Vancouver.

Responsibilities

You will build and extend an agentic harness for game logic generation, covering tool orchestration, context management, and integration of these capabilities into the engine.
You will partner with engine developers, integrating creator-focused systems into our core engine architecture to enable generative creation workflows.
You will implement guardrails including sandboxed execution, permissioned tool access, content-safety and IP checks, and human review points before generated content reaches players.
You will build evaluation for agent output, including whether a generated game compiles, loads, holds frame rate, and matches intent, and turn those checks into automated regression suites that gate harness changes.
You will partner with researchers, developers, artists, and designers to translate prototypes into production-ready engine features, ensuring alignment with existing systems.
You will design extensible interfaces that allow rapid iteration on new technologies while maintaining architectural integrity and developer usability.
You will define how you productize new technologies within the engine, influencing architecture and creator experience.

Qualifications

3+ years of software development experience with AAA game engines (e.g., Frostbite, Unity, Unreal, Godot, or proprietary)
Expertise in C++
Experience with Python
Experience with agentic harnesses and workflows (Claude Code, Codex, Opencode)
Experience with context engineering, graph engineering, and long running workflow orchestration
Experience with one or more game engine development domains (e.g., gameplay, simulation, systems, content pipelines, and performance-critical systems)

jobs.title: AI-Native Mobile QA Engineer
jobs.description:
About Snaplii
Snaplii is a profitable Toronto fintech with 400,000+ users and 500+ brand partners, including Walmart, Costco, DoorDash and Uber. We run one of Canada's most-used payment and rewards wallets, and we are building the payment layer that AI agents use to buy things.

The role
Most of our regression testing is already done by AI. We need someone who can run that setup, decide what it should test next, and catch what it misses. You will be the person who knows whether a release is safe to ship.

You take over a working test process from the person who built it, with a full handover, and a senior engineer on the team is your go-to while you settle in. After that, quality on the Snaplii app is yours. You work every day with our developers on one side and our customer support team on the other.

What you'll do
Test the Snaplii iOS and Android apps before every release, focusing on the flows where mistakes cost money: sign-up and login, top-ups, payments, refunds, and gift card purchase and redemption.
Use AI tools, mainly Claude and Codex, to write test cases, generate test data and keep the automated suites up to date, and check their output instead of trusting it blindly.
Grow our automated mobile tests and choose what is worth automating next.
Turn bugs into reports a developer can fix without asking you anything else, and follow each one until it is closed.
Take issues that users report to support, reproduce them, and explain back to the support team in plain words what happened and when it will be fixed.

What you'll learn
How a payments app is tested when real money moves, including the ugly cases: a payment that goes through twice, a refund that half arrives, a phone that loses signal mid-checkout.
How to build a QA practice where AI does most of the repetitive work and you do the judgement.
How releases, incidents and fixes work end to end in a small team, where you see the whole picture instead of one corner of it.

What we look for
About 1 to 2 years of hands-on QA experience on mobile apps (iOS, Android or both). Co-op and internship work counts.
Some experience with mobile test automation (for example Appium, Maestro, Detox, XCUITest or Espresso) or with AI-based testing. You don't need all of these. We want to see something you built and can talk through.
You already use AI tools in your daily work and can show us how.
You write clearly, and you can explain the same bug to an engineer and to a support agent.
You are patient with repetitive work and you don't let a bug go until it is fixed.
Mandarin and English, professional working proficiency. Our developers and support team work in both, and we verify both in the first call.
Able to work on-site in Etobicoke, Monday to Friday.

Compensation and support
Compensation: CAD $60,000 to $90,000 base salary, depending on experience.
AI tools: you get Claude and Codex, the tools the whole team works with every day, and every employee also has a monthly personal AI tool budget under our AI tools policy.
Immigration support: Snaplii provides LMIA and PNP employer sponsorship for team members who qualify.
Interview: a short screening call in both languages, then a hands-on session. We give you the Snaplii app and a flow to test, you bring whichever AI tools you use, and you show us how you find and report a bug. Then you meet the team.

Notices
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
We use AI tools to help screen, assess and organize applications. Final hiring decisions are made by people.
Applicants who are interviewed will hear from us about the outcome within 45 days of their final interview.

Accurate Indigenous Managers & Advisors (AIMA) partners with First Nations, Indigenous organizations, and businesses to deliver professional consulting, operational support, financial administration, human resources, and organizational development services.

Independent Work
Initiative

Professional Communication

Fast-paced environment requiring the management of multiple priorities while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

Why Join AIMA?

At AIMA, you'll become part of a collaborative team committed to supporting Indigenous communities through professional consulting and organizational services. Every role contributes to building stronger organizations, improving systems, and delivering meaningful results.

jobs.title: Applied Mathematician - AI Trainer
jobs.description:
DataAnnotation is looking for an experienced mathematician to design mathematical problems that today's leading AI models still get wrong. Models are fluent enough to produce an answer that looks right and a derivation that reads well. You bring the judgment to tell the difference between the two, and the tooling to prove it.

This is a new and growing area for our company, focused on teaching AI to reason correctly rather than plausibly. The work combines deep mathematical knowledge with strong coding skills: you design, test, and validate complex tasks yourself. Your task and your solution become the ground truth a model is scored against, so accuracy is the entire job.

Advantages Of Contracting With Us

You will be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Get access to projects at $40-$125 USD per hour, with bonuses on high-quality work

Responsibilities

Design complex mathematical tasks in your area of expertise
Define what a correct answer looks like and the standard a model has to meet
Test and validate the task yourself before you submit it
Write a step-by-step solution another researcher could reproduce
Design tasks a model cannot solve by replaying a known result, and flag where its reasoning breaks: invalid steps, unstated assumptions, right answers reached by wrong work
Work across numerical analysis, optimization, probability and statistics, applied analysis, and scientific machine learning

Qualifications

Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
An active research background in mathematics or statistics: advanced graduate student, postdoc, academic researcher, or industry practitioner
Strong coding skills. You write Python and work comfortably at a terminal as part of your research, not as a side interest
Familiarity with reproducible or containerized environments such as Docker is a plus

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Working understanding of several of the other areas above, enough to know what those workflows involve and how they are run (for example, a medicinal chemist who also understands how a screening cascade is built and how DMPK data feeds a lead optimization decision), so you can assess work in adjacent areas and point out what was done correctly or incorrectly.
Familiarity with drug discovery workflows end to end: how a program moves from target identification and validation, through hit finding and hit to lead, into lead optimization and candidate selection, and on into IND enabling studies.
Nice to have: experience across more than one modality (small molecule, biologics, cell or gene therapy) or more than one therapeutic area.

General Requirements

Master’s or PhD, or a current PhD candidate, in Biology or a directly related field (molecular or cell biology, genetics, immunology, neuroscience, biochemistry, bioinformatics, or computational biology), completed in the U.S., Canada, Europe, or the UK. For this role, directly related fields also include chemistry, medicinal chemistry, pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences, and toxicology.
3+ years of hands on experience in your subfield (see Domain qualifications above). Time in an academic lab or research institute counts after undergraduate education.
Able to draw on your own real world experience and day to day workflows to craft scenarios that test whether an AI system can actually do the work.
Hands on practitioner: you currently do (or recently did) the bench or analysis work yourself at an individual contributor level, not solely in a managerial capacity.
Full professional or native level written and spoken English, with strong written communication. You can explain complex scientific reasoning clearly and concisely, and articulate why a result is wrong, not only that it is.
Comfort with ambiguity and attention to detail. You can orient in a new set of files and build an accurate, deep working picture of it quickly, especially when the science sits partly or wholly outside your own specialization. You verify what a document claims against the underlying data.
Capable of interpreting feedback, judging which parts of it are actually correct, and applying it without hand holding. When stuck, you look for the answer rather than waiting for one.
Ability to ramp quickly on unfamiliar work from written material and instructions alone, including where that material is incomplete (for example, writing grading rubrics for the first time).
General familiarity with AI and LLM tools. You have used models like Claude or ChatGPT in life sciences professional work and have the judgment to tell a well reasoned answer from a plausible sounding but incorrect one.
Baseline tech literacy: comfortable with cloud file tools (e.g., Google Workspace), managing browser profiles, downloading and installing desktop apps (e.g., Claude), and everyday file handling (e.g., converting between Excel and Google Sheets, zipping files for sharing).
Available at least 10 hours per week, with no weekly maximum. Consistent availability is valued and more hours are welcome.
Based in the United States, Canada, or the UK (Ireland and Australia may also be accepted).

Compensation And Terms

Pay: $40-125/hr USD. Paid via PayPal on a regular cadence.
Contract position. Fully remote. Minimum 10 hours per week with no weekly maximum.
Flexible scheduling. Multi day task timers let you spread work across days.
Access to Claude and ChatGPT is provided through the project; no personal subscription is required.

What To Expect

Apply through the posting link and create your account.
Complete the skills assessment (about 1-2 hours). It tests domain fit, careful reading, task design, rubric judgment and your response to feedback on a prompt. All work must be your own; submissions produced with AI tools are rejected, and this is the single most common reason candidates do not pass.
Our team reviews your assessment. If you pass, you complete onboarding and a short training project that walks through how tasks, files, and rubrics are built.
Propose a task from your professional experience: the scenario, the prompt, the files you will build or choose to use, and where you expect the model to fail. An expert reviewer reads it and sends written feedback either way.
Once your proposal is accepted, build the task in full and run it against frontier models. Every completed task goes through expert review, and experienced contributors are invited to review and refine other experts’ tasks.

Each stage is a gate: work must be accepted before you move on. You are compensated for every step you complete, but not every submission is accepted. Feedback and revision are a normal part of the process. Support is available through platform instructions, onboarding materials, a dedicated Slack channel, and office hours.

About DataAnnotation

DataAnnotation works with frontier AI labs building the world’s most advanced models, with the goal of enabling human aligned AI. Our expert programs bring together practicing professionals to evaluate and improve what these models can do in their fields.

DataAnnotation believes that human expertise is essential to building trustworthy AI. We don’t want AI training AI. We want real scientists in the room. If you have a strong life sciences background and want to put it to work in a new way, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Computational Physicist - AI Trainer
jobs.description:
DataAnnotation is looking for an experienced physicist to design physics problems that today's leading AI models still get wrong. Models routinely produce derivations that break conservation laws and reach results no working physicist would accept. You bring the subject knowledge to catch these errors, and the tooling to prove them.

This is a new and growing area for our company, focused on teaching AI to reason correctly rather than plausibly. The work combines deep physics knowledge with strong coding skills: you design, test, and validate complex tasks yourself. Your task and your solution become the ground truth a model is scored against, so accuracy is the entire job.

Advantages Of Contracting With Us

You will be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
Get access to projects at $40-$125 USD per hour, with bonuses on high-quality work

Responsibilities

Design complex physics tasks in your area of expertise
Define what a correct answer looks like and the standard a model has to meet
Test and validate the task yourself before you submit it
Write a step-by-step solution another researcher could reproduce
Design tasks a model cannot solve by replaying a known result, and flag where its physical reasoning breaks: dimensional and sign errors, invalid approximations, violated conservation laws, unphysical results
Work across computational physics, simulation, numerical methods, data analysis, and theoretical modeling

Qualifications

Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
An active research background in physics or a closely related field: advanced graduate student, postdoc, academic researcher, or industry practitioner
Strong coding skills. You write Python and work comfortably at a terminal as part of your research, not as a side interest
Familiarity with reproducible or containerized environments such as Docker is a plus

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!
About Tailscale
Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.
Job Description
We’re seeking a skilled and diligent full-time Software Engineer to join our growing Control Plane Team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:
Develop the Tailscale product, contributing to both open source client code and related backend services;
Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making;
Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.
Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward at crucial intersections of the technology and organization: in this case, the control plane and the various services it comprises and supports. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.
Key Responsibilities
Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core software components.
Develop product features in areas that include our control plane, our relay infrastructure, and our identity integrations.
Exhibit ownership over the running services that comprise Tailscale’s product by building for observability, participating in incident response, and fielding customer support escalations.
Analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various system resources.
Bring a security-first mindset to both design and implementation.
What We Are Looking For
Experience with distributed systems
Experience with the Go programming language
Experience with one or more SQL databases

Ability to give and process constructive feedback, as well as work independently
Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Product - Backend)
jobs.description:
**About Vasco**
---------------

Vasco is the revenue context layer for AI agents. The product was built around one idea: confident is not the same as correct, and revenue decisions get made on confidence all the time. We structure your CRM, billing, calls, and support data into a semantic layer where every metric is sourced, every definition is locked, and every answer is deterministic, then build agents that take the manual busywork off people's plates.

Our cofounders Guillaume and Seb already built and sold one startup together; today they are building the product they wished they had. Vasco's mission is to enable builders and GTM leaders to build a revenue engine that moves the business forward on data they can trust.

Curious how we build? Take a look at our young engineering blog.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Software Engineer at Vasco, you'll build the brain of our agents: the core systems that give them the context, metrics, and playbooks they need to do their job. You'll join a small team of product designers and engineers reporting to our CTO, and work closely with our DevOps, Platform, Data, and Agent teams. The mission is to make GTM agents production-ready: reliable, fast, context-aware, and triggered at the right moment. You'll help shape solutions, then carry them through implementation to release. Twelve months in, winning means our agents run on systems you shaped, shipped, and saw adopted, and you’re able to tackle hard and crunchy problems.

We're open to different levels of seniority. This is not an entry-level position: the problems are hard, the architecture is complex, and you'll own technical decisions and their implementation. We expect high autonomy and accountability at every level, and the scope you own grows with your experience. We'll meet you where you are, and what matters is that you make the team better and more capable of facing complex technical challenges.

We're an early-stage startup working at the frontier of what agents can do in GTM. The path is often foggy, so you should be ready to bring clarity to it with your team, stretch beyond your comfort zone, stay open-minded, and wear more hats than your title suggests. You're AI-forward and you actively contribute to how we work with AI as a team. AI can make engineering lonely, and we push back on that with close collaboration, a fun environment, and a team that stays human.

*For transparency, the internal title for this role is Software Developer.*

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Backend-focused, full-slice development:** Design, build, and ship the backend behind Vasco, including challenging parts like our context graph and our metric engine, where formula accuracy is key, and own full slices of work, including front end and data visualization when the feature calls for it, with human review sized to the risk.
* **Shaping to adoption:** Shape solutions with designers, engineers, and GTM teammates in our Shape Up process, at the technical level and the business level, turn intent and design into the right context for Claude to implement, then instrument the release and follow adoption with your team.
* **Infrastructure, security, and data trust:** Build services that handle customer revenue data safely and own the infrastructure and security of the parts you build, with guidance and tooling from DevOps, since the product's promise rests on data our customers can trust.
* **AI-native practices:** Help build our backend harness and blueprints, the standards Claude reads so it builds the way we want, so more of your time goes to thinking, technical design, and shaping as AI handles more of the mechanical coding.
* **Incident ownership:** Own your incidents: if you break something in production, you fix it, and you step up for your team the same way, communicating fast and transparently so we know about problems before customers do, because reliability is what we sell.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* **Customer-facing systems.** You've spent at least four years building systems that have touched customers, and your technical decisions trace back to the customer problems they solve.
* **Backend depth.** You've designed, built, and operated production backend services, you design complete systems with the big picture of a feature in mind, and you're comfortable working on a data-heavy infrastructure product like ours. Experience with part of our stack (GCP, BigQuery, Node.js, TypeScript, Terraform) or its equivalents in other clouds is ideal.
* **AI-forward, with healthy skepticism.** You've made AI coding tools central to how you ship, you own and can defend the output you ship, and you build the checks that let you ship with evidence. We'll ask you to show how you run your development lifecycle with AI.
* **High-stakes judgment.** You've made decisions where the cost of being wrong was real, at the scale you've worked at, and you can walk through how you decided.
* **Communication clarity.** You can turn technical trade-offs into clear business impact for any audience, from developers to cofounders.
* **Collaboration.** You've pulled people into your work, you enjoy working as a team, and you contribute to the culture around you.

**What'll make you stand out**
------------------------------

* **Rust or Go.** You've shipped production services in Rust or Go, which we're seriously considering alongside TypeScript and Node for high-performance, type-safe workloads.
* **Context layers for agents.** You've built data or context layers that AI agents consume in production, including context graph architectures.
* **Data engineering or DevOps range.** You can drop into data engineering work (SQL, data modeling, pipelines) or DevOps work (infrastructure, CI/CD, observability) when the problem calls for it.

You will design and implement new features in PK’s software projects: Loudspeaker remote control application (.dynamics), mobile applications, and internal PK software tools to aid in development and manufacturing. You will also participate in shaping the future of the software department at PK Sound, helping make long-term technology choices to improve and scale the software. Working with customers across the globe on some of the highest-profile events and venues, what you create will have a significant impact not only for the company but the millions of people who enjoy experiencing our loudspeakers.

ABOUT PK SOUND

PK Sound is an owner-operated, advanced loudspeaker manufacturer, proudly headquartered in Calgary, Alberta Canada, servicing the world. We pride ourselves on being a fresh alternative to the status quo, providing creative and innovative solutions in an ever-evolving marketplace. It is one thing to hear music, it is another to experience it. PK Sound was born out of the marriage of acoustic engineering and human emotion, in facilitation of the connection between artist and fan. We measure performance as much in the reaction of a devoted fan as in the read-out of a lab instrument. In all we do, wherever the PK logo appears, there can be no compromise, and no end in our desire to achieve new standards of performance, better ways of collaboration, and new avenues of innovation to advance industry technology for all.

There is no doubt we work hard, but we share in the success, and we have a lot of fun doing it. jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
**Full-Stack Developer (Canada)**

**Employment Type:** Full-time, contract-to-hire  
**Location:** Remote (Canada), with occasional in-person company events

**About Us**

We're a venture-backed startup building software that solves real-world business problems. Engineering sits at the center of how we operate: a small team, short feedback loops, and a lot of ownership per person.

**Job Overview**

As a Full-Stack Developer, you'll help build scalable, reliable applications across the entire stack: **NestJS** and **Node.js** on the backend, **ReactJS** and **TypeScript** on the frontend, **Supabase** and **TypeORM** for data, and **AWS Fargate/ECS** for deployment.

We also expect fluency with **AI coding tools**. They're part of how this team ships, not an optional extra, and we're looking for someone who uses them well and knows when not to trust them.

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to take features from idea to production. While this is a remote role, we get together in person for company events, and we expect you to join them.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain scalable applications using NestJS, Node.js, ReactJS, and TypeScript.
* Design and evolve Postgres data models through Supabase and TypeORM, including entities, relations, migrations, query performance, and row-level security.
* Use Supabase platform features (auth, storage, realtime, edge functions) where they're the right fit.
* Deploy, run, and monitor containerized services on AWS Fargate and AWS ECS.
* Implement serverless components on AWS where they improve performance or cost.
* Build and maintain efficient backend services and APIs.
* Build high-performance, responsive frontend applications.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow, and review their output critically before it ships.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, keeping system reliability high.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code.
* Perform code reviews and help hold the bar on engineering practices.
* Keep current with the tools and patterns that are actually moving the industry.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong knowledge of **NestJS** and **Node.js** for building backend services and APIs.
* Solid understanding of **ReactJS** for dynamic, responsive frontends.
* Proficiency in **TypeScript** across both frontend and backend.
* Hands-on experience with **Supabase**, including Postgres, auth, storage, and row-level security.
* Working knowledge of **TypeORM**: entities, relations, migrations, and the query builder.
* Practical, day-to-day experience with **AI coding assistants**, plus the judgment to know when their output needs to be rewritten or thrown away.
* Familiarity with microservices architectures and containerization.
* Experience with modern version control (Git).
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team.
* Strong communication skills in English, written and verbal.
* **Must be willing to attend in-person company events.**
* **Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience with AWS Fargate and AWS ECS for deploying and managing containerized applications.
* Experience with other AWS services such as Lambda, S3, RDS, and CloudFormation.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs into product features.
* Exposure to Auth0 or similar third-party auth providers (useful, though most of our auth runs through Supabase).
* Comfort working in an Agile team.

Pay: $90,000.00-$120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Growth Marketer, AI-Native based in Canada.

As a Growth Marketer, AI-Native, you will turn marketing concepts into live creative assets, campaigns, and experiences that drive measurable growth.

You will use generative AI and modern marketing tools to create advertising, landing pages, imagery, and video at speed.

The role combines creative production, experimentation, performance marketing, and analytics in a highly hands-on environment.

You will launch A/B tests, monitor performance, identify what works, and continuously iterate based on real customer and campaign data.

You will work directly with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and internal attribution tools to connect activity with business outcomes.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys building independently, experimenting with emerging technology, and learning quickly.

You will have significant ownership and autonomy, with an expectation that you can move ideas from concept to live experiment without relying heavily on separate design or development teams.

Accountabilities

Turn product and campaign concepts into finished advertising creative for platforms such as Google and Meta.
Build and refine landing pages using AI-powered page-generation tools, including hands-on adjustments where needed to improve quality and performance.
Produce realistic, brand-consistent imagery and video using current generative AI and creative tools.
Maintain a consistent visual identity across advertising, landing pages, and other published marketing assets.
Evaluate AI-generated creative critically and refine outputs so that finished work feels polished, authentic, and aligned with the brand.
Design and run A/B tests across landing pages, advertising creative, messaging, and other growth initiatives.
Define clear testing hypotheses, success criteria, and measurement approaches before launching experiments.
Analyze test results, scale successful approaches, discontinue underperforming variants, and continuously iterate based on learnings.
Monitor key performance indicators including conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, return on ad spend, and funnel drop-off.
Work regularly with GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and internal attribution and analytics dashboards.
Translate performance data into clear actions and communicate what is working, what is not, and what should change next.
Maintain a strong connection between the assets and campaigns you create and the measurable business results they generate.
Stay current with emerging AI tools and experiment with new workflows that can improve marketing speed, quality, and effectiveness.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in growth, performance, digital marketing, or a closely related field, with demonstrable work and results.
Strong hands-on experience using AI tools for creative production, imagery, copy, landing-page generation, or related marketing workflows.
A portfolio demonstrating live landing pages and advertising creative that you personally produced.
Strong understanding of marketing analytics and the ability to use performance data to make independent decisions.
Practical experience designing, launching, analyzing, and acting on A/B tests.
Excellent written English and the ability to create clear, compelling marketing content.
Strong visual judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to identify and improve weaknesses in advertising and landing-page creative.
Highly self-directed and comfortable operating independently without a large marketing team or extensive support functions.
A proactive, experimental mindset and genuine curiosity about emerging AI and marketing technologies.
Ability to move quickly from idea to execution, learn from results, and continuously improve.
Hands-on experience with paid social and paid search platforms is an asset.
Experience with AI-powered video generation and video editing is an asset.
Startup or early-stage company experience, particularly where you independently owned a marketing channel, is an asset.

Benefits

Opportunity to work in an AI-native marketing environment where AI is integrated into creative production, analytics, and internal workflows.
High degree of autonomy and ownership over growth marketing initiatives.
Hands-on exposure to emerging generative AI tools and modern marketing technologies.
Opportunity to build and test creative rapidly across paid advertising and landing-page experiences.
Direct involvement in performance analytics and data-driven experimentation.
Remote-friendly opportunity based in Ontario, Canada.
Fast-moving environment suited to marketers who enjoy experimentation, ownership, and continuous learning.
Opportunity to contribute to a digital-first healthcare environment focused on expanding access to care.

Automated Testing: Develop, maintain, and execute automated browser and end-to-end tests to ensure application quality.
Pipeline Management: Collaborate on configuring, maintaining, and automated testing via CI/CD coded pipelines.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role

Core Programming & Frameworks (Any or All)

Languages: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Java, and SQL.
Front-End: Modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular.
Back-End: Frameworks like .NET, Node.js, or Java SpringBoot.
Development Environments: Familiarity with modern IDEs such as VS Code, Visual Studio, or IntelliJ.

Version Control & CI/CD Pipelines

Source Control: Strong Git SCM skills, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
Automation: Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and coded pipelines like GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, or AWS Code Pipeline.

Model Understanding: Deep fundamental or hands-on understanding of AI model optimization, training, iterative testing, and performance validation.

Continuous Learner: Highly adaptable mindset with a proven ability to pick up new programming languages, frameworks, and cloud services quickly.

Communicator: Clear verbal and written skills to work effectively within an agile team environment.

jobs.description:
Solace helps companies connect and integrate all of their assets through the power of event-

driven architecture. Our technology makes it easy to unlock data silos and capture events

occurring across large enterprises; stream information about those events everywhere it needs

to be in real-time; and give the apps, AI agents and people who receive it the power to

immediately react with decisive actions and smart decisions.

Many of the world’s biggest companies trust Solace to modernize their IT infrastructure by

embracing trends like AI, cloud and IoT so they can create awesome experiences for their

customers, partners and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance

on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your

hard work!

About The Role

As a Junior Software Engineer on the Message Spool team, you will work with senior engineers

to build and improve the persistence layer of the Solace Event Broker. This system handles high

volumes of messages and guarantees delivery at scale.

We use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day. They help us build faster and keep our code

quality high. We care more about how you think and solve problems than about years of

experience. If you are quick to learn, comfortable with AI tools, and like figuring things out on

your own, this role is for you.

What You’ll Work On

You will help build new features for the message spool subsystem. You will work with:

Core Technologies: C and C++ on Linux, multithreading, and storage systems.
Development Tools: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and AI coding

assistants.

Learning Opportunities: performance analysis, debugging complex systems, and making

them more reliable and scalable.

You will use AI tools like Claude Code every day, to write code, test, and debug.

Key Requirements

AI aptitude: you are quick to learn and comfortable using AI tools like Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, or Cursor to build, test, and debug. If you have not used these tools yet, you are excited

to start.

Independent problem solving: you can take a task, figure out an approach, and get unstuck

without much hand holding.

Culture fit: you care about craftsmanship, you are honest about what you know and do not

know, and you work well with a team.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical

Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

Solid foundation in C or C++ and comfortable in a Linux environment.
Good written and verbal communication skills, for code reviews and working in an Agile team.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have, not required:

You have used AI tools to speed up learning or shipping work, in personal projects or a job.
Personal projects or open source work that show you can drive something on your own.
Modern C++ (C++11 and later) and the STL.
Multithreaded programming and a basic understanding of concurrency.
Debugging or profiling tools, like gdb, valgrind, or perf.
Familiarity with storage systems, databases, or file I/O.
Understanding of distributed systems or high availability.

What You’ll Learn

Production C and C++ systems: work on systems that run in production and handle real

customer traffic.

Storage and persistence: learn how we persist messages, optimize storage, and keep the system

reliable.

Modern development practices: learn AI-assisted development, CI/CD automation, and testing.
Distributed systems: get exposure to scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.
Mentorship: work closely with senior engineers who will help you grow.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom,

momentum, humility, and human experience.

Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like

MITT and this (check them out!).

At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process. To help

identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence

(AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes

to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening — including interviews and final hiring—

are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

Role Status: EXISTING

Expected Salary Range: Expected salary range for this role is from $85,000 to $105,000. The final offer within this range will reflect the successful candidate’s skills and experience.

Let’s Talk

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential

and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support

you.

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only

those selected to move forward will be contacted.

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business

and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are.

If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we

encourage you to join us!

Alair Team members are engaged, determined, and disciplined in helping develop our franchise partners' businesses to new heights and successes. Since being founded in Nanaimo in 2007, we have grown exponentially across North America, while maintaining our family-oriented, collaborative style of business.
Learn more about Alair at www.alairhomes.com

Job Description

This position is within the Technology department for Home Office.

This position is home based and will be interacting with a team spread across Canada and United States.

We are looking for a Test Automation Developer with strong Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript skills to join the APEX Product Team. APEX is our internal platform: a React/TypeScript Single Page Application backed by PHP Laravel APIs that communicate with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. You will own and grow our automated test suite across the UI, Backend APIs, and the flow of data back into Business Central, so the team can ship quickly and with confidence.

This role is open to developers early in their career. If you have around two years of hands-on test automation with JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright, we want to hear from you.

How We Work

We operate in a Product Operating Model: small empowered teams, outcome-focused goals, and continuous discovery. Quality is a shared responsibility. Developers write tests first on business logic and critical UI flows, and you partner with Developers and Product/Design to turn Acceptance Criteria into test cases, decide where each test belongs, and keep feedback loops fast.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain end-to-end test automation in Playwright across APEX modules, APIs, and Business Central integration points.
Take ownership of the existing automation: review it, refactor it, and remove flakiness and duplication.
Decide where coverage matters most using a risk-based approach, focusing on critical paths and high-impact areas.
Keep tests isolated with independent data per test and no cascading failures between apps.
Validating reported defects, and creating well-documented tickets that enable efficient debugging and resolution by development teams
Work with Developers on the handoff from Acceptance Criteria to test cases, and review test code in pull requests.
Integrate the suite into CI so it runs reliably, in parallel, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback.
Actively look for leverage: automation, reuse, modularity, documentation, self-serve tools.

Core Competencies and Required Skills and Experience

Test Automation (non-negotiable): Proven experience with test automation using JavaScript.
Playwright: Strong experience with locator-based (web-first) assertions and multi-project configurations.
JavaScript​: Comfortable writing it daily, and able to read and reason about both UI and API code.
API Testing: Solid experience testing REST APIs, ideally a Laravel backend. You call endpoints directly for setup and contract tests, and you know when the UI is actually the thing under test.
Risk-Based Coverage: You prioritize critical paths and high-impact areas rather than chasing coverage numbers.-
Test Design Judgment: You can explain the difference between types and benefits of different tests, and appropriateness for a situation.
Teamwork and Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Comfortable pairing with Developers, giving and receiving feedback in code review, and explaining quality risks to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

TypeScript: Ability to read and reason about Types, Safety, and proper use.
Experience testing ERP or other stateful back-office systems, especially Business Central, including API-first setup (OData / custom API pages) and isolated test companies.
PHP / Laravel backend familiarity.
CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar) and running tests in parallel.
Exposure to Product Management or Design practices.
Familiarity with the Construction industry, Franchise models, and Construction Project Management.
Interest in evaluating AI features (AI evals).

What Success Looks Like

30 Days:
Environment set up, pairing with the team to onboard, understanding domain basics, and a first review of the existing automation.
60 Days:
Contributing test code to the main branch regularly, with a clear plan for refactoring the existing suite.
90 Days:
One module fully covered by automated E2E tests (for example, the Invoices Module: Backend APIs and UI through to Business Central), and the existing automation refactored and cleaned up.
6 Months:
The APEX Product Team ships meaningfully faster because of reliable, trusted test automation.
1 Year+:
Helping define and build evaluation (AI evals) for AI features in our products.

Compensation:
$90,000 – $100,000 CAD per year

Les candidats doivent être légalement autorisés à travailler au Canada. Ce poste n’est pas admissible au parrainage et nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer un candidat ou de participer à son parrainage pour l’obtention d’un visa d’emploi ou d’un permis de travail.

Aon a pour vocation de favoriser une meilleure prise de décisions

Chez Aon, nous contribuons à une meilleure prise de décisions afin de protéger et d’enrichir la vie des gens dans le monde entier.

En tant qu’organisation, nous sommes unis par la confiance en une équipe inclusive et nous sommes passionnés par la réussite de nos employés et de nos clients.

À quoi vous attendre au quotidien

Assurer la maintenance et l’amélioration de nos applications internes conçues avec C#, .NET et SQL Server, notamment en ajoutant de nouvelles fonctionnalités, en améliorant la convivialité et en corrigeant les bogues signalés par les utilisateurs.
Répondre aux demandes ponctuelles de données des employés en extrayant, en validant et en formatant l’information provenant de nos systèmes pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels, d’affaires et de production de rapports.
Concevoir et soutenir des solutions d’automatisation (publipostage, macros Excel, utilitaires C#, requêtes Access, scripts SQL) qui rationalisent les flux de travail au bureau et améliorent l’efficacité.
Agir comme intermédiaire entre les utilisateurs d’affaires et les services de TI d’Aon, en aidant à traduire les besoins des utilisateurs en demandes techniques (p. ex. modifications d’applications, accès à des dossiers ou au réseau, mises à jour des autorisations).
Travailler en partenariat avec les équipes de TI d’Aon pour coordonner et tester les mises à niveau des systèmes, les correctifs et les changements d’infrastructure, afin de garantir que nos applications demeurent stables et disponibles avec un minimum d’interruptions.
Élaborer et maintenir des rapports opérationnels (par exemple, des rapports de présence et d’autres rapports clés de rendement ou opérationnels) à l’aide d’outils comme Crystal Reports, Excel et SQL.
Documenter les changements, les processus et les guides de l’utilisateur afin de favoriser le transfert des connaissances et d’offrir des références claires tant pour les équipes techniques que pour les utilisateurs non techniques.
Participer aux réunions d’équipe régulières pour discuter des priorités, examiner le travail à venir, et proposer des idées pour améliorer nos systèmes et nos processus.

Ce poste offre l’occasion d’observer le cycle de vie complet des outils et applications internes, depuis la compréhension des besoins des utilisateurs finaux jusqu’à la conception, la création, les tests, le déploiement et le soutien continu. Excellentes compétences en Excel (formules, fonctions, tri/filtrage)
L’expérience d’intégration programmatique avec les applications Microsoft Office constitue un atout
Connaissance de base de SharePoint
