jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Automation
jobs.description:
#### **About us**



Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.


Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**



We are hiring a Software Engineer for the Automation team to use AI to solve and automate manual work across Coalition. This is a hands\-on AI engineering role: authoring skills, wiring agents to our systems of record through MCP, building evals, and deploying agents that non\-engineers depend on every day. You will not be starting from zero. We have early workflows live in production, more proofs of concept in the oven, and working hypotheses about how all of this should fit together. We want someone who will pressure test those hypotheses against their own experience and change our minds where we have it wrong. Deep, current, practical experience building with LLMs is the single most important qualification for this job.



The other half of the role is proximity to the business. Think of this as a Forward Deployed Engineer, pointed inward: your customers are other Coalition teams. You will work directly with the teams whose work we are automating, learn how they actually operate, and turn that into a playbook. Getting from that conversation to something an agent can run reliably is the core of the work. You will also work day to day with our data team to get at the data these agents depend on. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.



#### **Responsibilities**


* **Author skills:** Turn a team's process, judgment, and edge cases into reusable skills that agents can invoke. Write them so the next project can reuse them instead of rebuilding them.
* **Build within our agent architecture:** Wire agents to the systems of record through MCP servers, compose skills and tools into working workflows, and add new MCP surface area when a system we need is not covered yet.
* **Build evals:** Define what "correct" means with the business team before you build. Build the eval set, establish a baseline, and use it to make calls about what ships. Nothing goes live on vibes.
* **Deploy and support agents:** Take agents from prototype to production, including permissions, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and rollback. Tune from how they behave once real users are in front of them, and leave behind docs and an owner on the business team who can run it without you.
* **Partner with the data team:** Work with our data engineers on the access, models, and quality of the data your agents read and write. Bring them requirements early rather than working around them.

#### **Skills and Qualifications**


* **AI application building (primary):** Substantial hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-backed applications: prompting, tool use, agentic loops, and multi\-step workflows. You know where these break and how to contain the damage when they do. You have shipped at least one agent that non\-engineers depend on.
* **Agent tooling:** Practical experience with MCP, skill or tool authoring, and orchestrating agents against real systems of record.
* **Evals:** You have built eval sets and used them to make decisions, not just to make a slide look good.
* **Coding agents:** Fluent with agentic coding tools like Cursor. You use them to move faster inside codebases you did not write.
* **Core development:** Strong Python. Comfortable with SQL and working directly against production data models.
* **Business fluency:** You can sit with a non\-technical operator, map their process, and translate it into requirements without a PM in the room.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:** Undocumented processes, half\-broken internal tools, and unclear ownership are the normal starting conditions. You find the thread and pull it.
* **Shipping discipline:** Git, CI, containers, and enough operational instinct to deploy your own work and keep it healthy.
* **Experience:** At least 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience. It's not the years, it's the miles.


**Bonus Points**


* Experience building or maintaining MCP servers.
* Prior solutions engineering, professional services, internal tools, or startup founding experience.
* Working knowledge of the systems we automate against: Linear, Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, Snowflake.
* Insurance, fintech, or another regulated domain where being wrong has a compliance cost.

#### **Compensation**



As a remote\-first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several Canadian geographic markets.



In Alberta, British Columbia \& Ontario the base salary for this position ranges from $128,500/year up to $160,600/year.



For all other locations, the base salary for this position ranges from $115,600/year up to $144,540/year.



Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job\-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your Recruiter can share more on the specific target salary range for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

**Application Updates:** Consistent with our commitment to transparency, if you are interviewed for this role, we will provide a status update on your application within 45 days of your final interview.

At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.



We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work\-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.



To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.


We're looking for a technical writer to join our Tech Writing team — someone who thinks in systems as naturally as they think in sentences. At Braze, documentation is infrastructure: a connected, structured body of knowledge that both developers and machines read from, not a collection of individual pages. You'll spend as much time shaping how that knowledge is organized and generated as you will writing it.



Our documentation practice is already well established, with a mature style guide, writers who own specific product domains, and a workflow where AI\-assisted drafting sits alongside traditional technical writing. Your job is to push it forward on two fronts. The first is architectural: defining the metadata, taxonomy, and context our tooling relies on to produce useful first drafts. The second is editorial: becoming a genuine expert on Braze's platform and bringing the kind of scrutiny that turns a plausible draft into documentation our customers can actually trust — accurate, well\-structured, and consistent in voice with every other Braze experience.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Define and maintain the metadata (YAML front matter), taxonomy, and contextual guidelines that our AI\-assisted drafting workflows depend on
* Review and verify machine\-generated prose and code samples line by line, checking technical accuracy, edge\-case behavior, and voice before anything ships
* Write and revise API references, integration guides, and conceptual documentation in our docs\-as\-code environment, owning feature updates end to end
* Become an expert on the Braze platform, distilling complex functionality into approachable, user\-centric language
* Help oversee and maintain the documentation GitHub repository
* Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Marketing, and Implementation teams to pin down how the platform actually behaves and to validate real customer integration paths
* Organize content so it serves a developer mid\-integration and a system retrieving context — the same structure has to work for both
* Ensure documentation applies voice, style, and branding consistent with other client experiences
* Keep improving our documentation and client education experience through feedback\-gathering, research, experimentation, and data\-driven decisions
* Promote and foster knowledge exchange across teams


**WHO YOU ARE**


* 3\+ years writing documentation for genuinely technical audiences — APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms — with writing samples that show both range and precision
* Fluent in information architecture and knowledge management

jobs.title: Software Developer – Process Automation & AI
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a Software Developer to join our high\-impact development team with a focus on office automation and practical AI integration. This is a hands\-on position — you will identify, design, and deliver solutions that reduce repetitive manual work, connect existing systems, and help teams across the business work more efficiently.

This position is suited to someone who can evaluate a process and choose the right automation approach — robotic process automation, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, or a combination — then integrate it with our existing technology stack, including PHP applications, multi\-database environments, and ERP\-driven processes. Success is measured by tangible results in the areas we support — faster cycle time, cleaner data, and less repetitive work for the people closest to the process. We place a strong emphasis on leveraging AI\-assisted tools to enhance productivity and solution quality, and expect this person to apply those practices thoughtfully.

**Essential Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Partner with stakeholders in finance, purchasing, operations support, and other departments to map current processes and identify high\-value automation opportunities.
* Design, build, and maintain office and business\-process automation using the toolset that best fits the problem — including RPA platforms, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, and scheduled jobs.
* Integrate applications and data across our ERP and supporting systems so information moves reliably without duplicate data entry.
* Develop and support internal tools and intelligent assistants that help teams find information, complete routine requests, and stay consistent with established procedures.
* Contribute to PHP\-based applications and existing web stacks where automation needs to live inside current company platforms.
* Evaluate, prototype, and implement AI\-assisted capabilities in a practical, secure, and business\-appropriate way.
* Support future system implementations and process improvements, including potential people\-services system work, by building integrations and automating surrounding workflows.
* Write, optimize, and maintain queries and stored procedures across multiple database platforms as required by automation and reporting needs.
* Work closely with business analysts and/or directly with business stakeholders to gather, clarify, and refine requirements.
* Translate business needs into clear technical solutions with well\-defined scope and realistic timelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues promptly and thoroughly; monitor automated jobs and intervene when processes fail.
* Actively leverage AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, improve code quality, and solve problems more efficiently.
* Document systems, processes, and technical decisions to build institutional knowledge.
* Actively and enthusiastically engage in Company vision, mission and values.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education and Experience Required:**

* Post\-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field; equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
* 3\+ years of professional experience in software development, process automation, RPA, or a closely related technical role.
* Hands\-on experience delivering process automation using RPA platforms, workflow tools, scripting, APIs, or a comparable toolset.
* Proven experience with relational databases and SQL — ability to write and optimize queries and stored procedures is required.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders or analysts to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
* Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, large language models, and how they can be applied to internal tools or assisted workflows.
* Experience with Python and/or PHP for automation, scripting, integration, or application work is an asset.
* Experience with EDI (electronic data interchange) — including trading\-partner documents, mappings, and exception handling — is an asset.
* Experience with IBM DB2 for i (iSeries/AS400\) is a significant asset.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL is an asset.
* Experience with n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or similar workflow / RPA platforms is an asset.
* Experience in a manufacturing or industrial software environment, and familiarity with ERP\-driven business processes, is an asset.
* Experience with version control (Git or similar) is an asset.

**Skills and Attributes Required:**

· Authentically curious about how the business actually works and willing to sit with users to understand the real process, not just the system screen.

· Solutions\-focused — strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills.

· Comfortable working independently and taking full ownership of work from discovery through deployment and support.

· Excellent communication skills — able to translate clearly between technical and non\-technical audiences.

· Pragmatic about AI and automation — interested in tools that are reliable, auditable, and appropriate for the risk of the process.

· Ability to work effectively as part of a small, collaborative team.

· Driven to learn and adopt new technologies, but pragmatic and practical in problem solving.

· Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and shifting workloads.

· Good organizational and time management skills.

**Email your resume/cover letter to hr@monarchindustries.com**

Benefits:

* Company events
* Employee assistance program
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Junior AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Scispot® is the data and automation layer for self‑driving labs. We give diagnostics, biotech, and testing teams a flexible backbone that can stand in for traditional ELN, LIMS, SDMS, and QMS tools. Connect instruments. Standardize data. Automate workflows. Collaborate in real time. No code.
  
**Junior Automation Engineer**
------------------------------


Scispot is hiring a Junior Automation Engineer to help build the systems and workflows that make our teams more efficient, connected, and scalable.


You will work closely with our operations and GTM teams to turn manual processes into reliable automations. Your primary tools will be **HubSpot**, **n8n**, and AI\-assisted coding tools such as **Cursor** and Claude.


This is a hands\-on, growth\-oriented role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning quickly, and building practical automation systems.


**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Build and maintain workflow automations in n8n.
* Configure and improve HubSpot workflows, CRM processes, lead routing, notifications, property updates, and reporting support.
* Use Cursor and Claude to write, troubleshoot, and improve JavaScript, API requests, and data transformations.
* Connect business tools through APIs, webhooks, and integrations to reduce manual work and improve data quality.
* Work with sales, customer success, marketing, operations, and product teams to identify and implement automation opportunities.
* Document workflows and processes so they are clear, maintainable, and scalable.
* Monitor automations, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve existing systems.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, properties, lists, pipelines, and CRM processes.
* Hands\-on experience building workflows in n8n.
* Experience using Cursor for coding, debugging, or building automation\-related solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast\-moving startup environment.

Everything else can be taught. We care most about curiosity, ownership, practical technical ability, and the motivation to build better systems.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience supporting business operations, revenue operations, sales operations, or customer success operations.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, JSON, JavaScript, or other automation platforms.
* Experience working in a SaaS, biotech, or life sciences environment.

**Why Scispot**
---------------


* Build automations that have a direct, visible impact on how the company operates.
* Work closely with founders and cross\-functional teams.
* Develop practical skills across HubSpot, n8n, AI\-enabled workflows, APIs, and business systems.

NOC 2021: 21234 – Web developers and programmers (TEER 1\)

**Employer:** HECOD Blockchain Inc.  
**Work location:** 422 Richards St. Suite \#170, Vancouver, BC V6B 2Z4  
**Employment type:** Full\-time, permanent  
**Hours:** 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday  
**Number of vacancies:** 1  
**Reports to:** Lead – Technology  
**Salary:** CA$73,230\.00 to CA$121,243\.10 per year  
**Benefits:** Dental coverage and paid time off  
**Start date:** March 2027 (tentative)  
**Language of work:** English

**ABOUT HECOD**

HECOD Blockchain Inc. is a Vancouver\-based applied technology company. We build software, workflow, and verifiable systems for markets that still run on disconnected spreadsheets, inboxes, and portals.

Our approach is "technology without ideology." We start with the operational problem and choose the tools after. Cloud infrastructure, conventional databases, APIs, workflow automation, and applied AI do most of the work. Blockchain is used only where shared verification and tamper\-evident records add practical value.

Our products:

* **HECOD Collect (controlled preview):** a receivables workspace for B2B service businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and shared inboxes. It brings invoices, follow\-up decisions, and customer responses into one reviewable record.
* **HECOD Shelfware (planned):** software spend and renewal control. It connects finance, IT, and department evidence so an owner can decide whether to keep, investigate, or change a subscription.
* **EVRAYO (in development):** an operating layer for private real estate that connects sponsors, property\-specific entities, and eligible investors from onboarding through distributions.
* **HECOD Block (invitation\-only):** our first launched product, a no\-code blockchain deployment platform.

We also deliver custom software, integration, and advisory work for small businesses, enterprises, and the public sector.

**THE ROLE**

You will build and maintain the web surfaces people actually use: the HECOD Collect application, the customer response portal, and the hecod.tech website.

Collect users are finance people and business owners working through overdue invoices. They need dense, readable tables, clear status, and no surprises. Their customers open a single link to respond about one invoice, often on a phone. The standard for both is calm, fast, accessible, and multilingual from the start.

**MAIN DUTIES**

* Research, design, develop, and produce websites and web applications
* Consult with stakeholders to develop and document website and application requirements
* Prepare mock\-ups, prototypes, and user flows, and develop site and application architecture
* Write, modify, integrate, and test code for web and mobile\-responsive applications
* Ensure proper integration of web applications with backend services, databases, and APIs
* Identify and communicate technical problems, processes, and solutions to the Lead – Technology and the team
* Research and evaluate web frameworks, software tools, and services
* Maintain websites and web applications, including updates, fixes, and performance improvements
* Prepare technical documentation for components and front\-end architecture

**DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES**  
HECOD Collect application

* Build data tables for invoices and customers with aging, balances, currency, and status, using tabular figures and right\-aligned amounts
* Build approval queues, reminder draft review screens, and follow\-up history views
* Build clear empty, loading, and error states: plain sentences and one action
* Show verified records with the approved verified icon and label, never decorative graphics

Customer response portal

* Build the scoped portal where a customer views one invoice and records a payment promise or dispute
* Make it work well on mobile, with minimal steps and no account required

Localization

* Support EN\-US, FR\-CA, ES, and DE across the application
* Handle language, currency, region, date format, and time zone as separate settings
* Work with translators and reviewers to keep strings accurate and consistent

Design system and accessibility

* Implement and maintain the HECOD design system: tokens, components, typography, and dark mode
* Meet WCAG 2\.2 AA for contrast, keyboard navigation, focus states, and screen readers
* Respect reduced\-motion settings; keep transitions short and purposeful

Website and performance

* Maintain hecod.tech and collect.hecod.tech marketing and documentation pages
* Monitor and improve page speed, Core Web Vitals, and reliability
* Write automated tests for components and critical user flows

**REQUIREMENTS**  
Education

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, OR
* College diploma in web development, computer programming, or a related program

Experience

* 3\+ years of professional web development experience
* Experience shipping and maintaining a production web application used by real customers

Technical skills

* Strong TypeScript and JavaScript
* Strong React
* Modern HTML and CSS, including responsive layout
* Building accessible interfaces to WCAG AA standards
* Integrating front ends with REST APIs or database\-backed services
* Front\-end testing (component and end\-to\-end)
* Git, code review, and CI/CD pipelines

Working skills

* Clear written communication in English
* Attention to detail in layout, spacing, and copy
* Comfortable working in a small team without layers of management

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion
* Supabase
* Experience with internationalization libraries and localized number, currency, and date formatting
* Experience building data\-heavy business or finance interfaces
* Experience with design tools such as Figma
* French, Spanish, or German proficiency
* A portfolio or code samples showing business application interfaces

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**  
First 3 months

* You understand Collect's interface, component library

The Syracuse Research Corporation (SRC) is celebrating 60 years of redefining possible.  

  

The company was originally formed to provide innovative products and seasoned analysis to solve complex Electronic Warfare (EW) challenges faced by the US Government and its Armed Forces. Since 2016, SRC has expanded operations into Australia, Canada and the UK. We do this by focusing on our customers’ needs through the innovative application of science, technology, and information to solve problems of national significance. SRC CAN Ltd is a wholly owned subsidiary of SRC Inc. and is helping to shape the future EW, Counter\-Uncrewed Aircraft System (CUAS) and Radar technologies that will support the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) and its allies.  

  

**The Job**  

  

SRC CAN Ltd is seeking a **Junior Software Developer** to contribute to the design, development, and delivery of next\-generation EW Operational Support Systems (EWOSS) including Intelligence Mission Data (IMD) and Operational Mission Data (OMD) product solutions for the Department of National Defence (DND). Reporting to the Senior Staff Software Developer, this role will leverage software engineering skillsets to support the SRC enterprise portfolio of signals intelligence (SIGINT) and EW suite of advanced software including Radio Frequency (RF) modeling and simulation products.  

  

This role requires strong technical and data engineering skills, collaboration, and familiarity with Agile methodologies such as the SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) environment.  

  

**Location: Hybrid \- Ottawa, Ontario.** We operate in a hybrid working environment. Normally, you will work out of the SRC CAN Ltd office.  

  

**What You’ll Do:*** Work with subject matter and domain experts to elicit software requirements.
* Contribute to software design, development, testing, and integration within an Agile environment.
* Contribute to continuous improvement across software development and processes.
* Monitor, manage, and report project status.

  

**What You’ll Bring:*** Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, think independently, and overcome technical challenges.
* Ability to work in multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Excellent English verbal/written communication skills. Proficiency in French is an asset.
* Candidates must be eligible to meet the requirements of export control and security regulations, including the Canadian Controlled Goods Program, and be eligible to hold a Government of Canada Level 2 (Secret) Security Clearance.

  

**Additional (Preferred) Requirements:*** Applied knowledge and experience with container technologies.
* Applied knowledge and experience with Java, Typescript, and Python.
* Applied knowledge and experience with React.
* Applied knowledge and experience with PostgreSQL.
* Applied knowledge and experience in VS Code.
* Applied knowledge and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines.
* Applied knowledge and experience with Linux and Windows operating systems.
* Comfortable working in cross\-functional roles.
* Excited to develop distributed software systems.
* Excited to engage in the Electronic Warfare Lifecycle domain.

  

**Additional Information**  

  

Total compensation for this role is market competitive. The anticipated salary range for this position based out of Ottawa, ON, is estimated at $60,000 to $87,550 annually.  

  

The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s EW domain knowledge, Software engineering experience, technical skills, and abilities, as well as other business and organizational needs.  

  

SRC CAN Ltd offers a comprehensive salary, vacation, and benefits package. We are extremely flexible around our 40\-hour working week. **We operate in a hybrid working environment with all staff being able to work remotely. Normally, you will work out of the SRC CAN Ltd office, (Gloucester, Ottawa, ON) and when required, in Department of National Defense (DND) facilities, such as the Shirley’s Bay and Tunney’s Pasture areas within the National Capital Region (NCR).**

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Emergency Call Handling
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Chez Motorola Solutions, nous pensons que tout commence par nos employés. Nous sommes une communauté mondiale soudée, unie par la volonté incessante de contribuer à la sécurité des personnes partout dans le monde. Nous concevons et connectons des technologies qui contribuent à protéger les personnes, les biens et les infrastructures. Nos solutions favorisent la collaboration essentielle pour améliorer la sécurité des populations, des écoles, des hôpitaux, des entreprises et, finalement, des nations. Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.

Présentation Du Département

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9-1-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. You’ll help influence architecture, build core product features, and shape how our team uses AI agents to move faster without compromising reliability, security, or product quality. We encourage engineers to use AI agents in their own work. But because this is mission-critical software, humans still own quality, judgment, and what ships.

What You’ll Do

Develop components for and integrate services into our Emergency Call Handling Systems
Develop Agentic AI-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.
Build strong habits around tests, code review, observability, and security from day one.
Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

You Might Be a Fit If

You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high-impact challenge.
You’re curious about working across backend, infrastructure, AI, and product, even if you haven’t done it all yet.
You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.
You care about quality — you write tests, read documentation, and try to understand a system before you change it.
You take feedback well and act on it.
You have strong product instincts and care about the humans using what you build.
You thrive in a team where you’ll have real ownership early — and you’re comfortable asking for help.

Relevant Experience

We don’t expect you to have shipped production systems. We care most about engineering fundamentals, learning velocity, curiosity, and how you think. Coursework, internships, research, and personal projects all count.

Relevant Exposure May Include

Projects involving AI agents, AI pipelines or RAG systems.
Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory
Programming in Python, C#, C++, Java, or similar languages
Comfortable scripting in both Linux and Windows and virtualization.
Telephony and voice infrastructure, including PSTN, SIP trunking, PBX, and call routing.

You do not need experience in all of these areas. Most successful candidates will have experience in a few and curiosity to learn the rest.

Target Base Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000 CAD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Description Du Poste

Nous recherchons un ingénieur logiciel pour se joindre à l'équipe de développement de la solution de gestion des appels VESTA 9-1-1. Dans ce rôle, vous exploiterez l'IA agentique pour créer des applications, automatiser les flux de travail DevOps et de cybersécurité, améliorant ainsi la qualité et l'efficacité opérationnelle.

Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'ingénieurs expérimentés sur les pipelines en temps réel, la téléphonie, l'infrastructure back-end et les interfaces produit. Vous contribuerez à influencer l'architecture, à concevoir des fonctionnalités fondamentales et à façonner la manière dont notre équipe utilise les agents d'IA pour progresser plus rapidement, sans faire de compromis sur la fiabilité, la sécurité ou la qualité du produit. Nous encourageons nos ingénieurs à utiliser des agents d'IA dans leur propre travail. Cependant, s'agissant d'un logiciel hautement critique, les humains conservent la responsabilité de la qualité, du jugement et de ce qui est déployé.

Ce que vous ferez

Développer des composants et intégrer des services dans nos systèmes de gestion des appels d'urgence.
Développer des flux de travail d'automatisation alimentés par l'IA agentique pour améliorer l'efficacité de nos tâches DevOps et de cybersécurité.
Contribuer à l'intégration de techniques d'IA pour améliorer l'évaluation, les tests et l'observabilité de nos systèmes.
Mettre la main à la pâte pour installer et configurer du matériel et des logiciels, y compris des équipements réseau et des serveurs.
Adopter de solides habitudes autour des tests, de la revue de code, de l'observabilité et de la sécurité dès le premier jour.
Poser des questions, chercher à comprendre le fonctionnement des systèmes et apporter des perspectives nouvelles à l'équipe.

Ce poste pourrait vous convenir si

Vous aimez transformer des procédures manuelles et fastidieuses en flux de travail autonomes basés sur l'IA, avant de vous lancer dans le prochain défi à fort impact.
Vous êtes curieux de travailler sur le back-end, l'infrastructure, l'IA et le produit, même si vous n'avez pas encore touché à tout.
Vous utilisez des outils d'IA au quotidien, mais vous ne confondez pas rapidité et qualité.
Vous vous souciez de la qualité : rédigez des tests, lisez la documentation et essayez de comprendre un système avant de le modifier.
Vous acceptez bien les commentaires et agissez en conséquence.
Vous avez un fort instinct produit et vous vous souciez des humains qui utilisent ce que vous construisez.
Vous vous épanouissez dans une équipe où vous aurez une réelle autonomie dès le début, tout en étant à l'aise pour demander de l'aide.

Expérience pertinente

Nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous ayez déjà déployé des systèmes en production. Nous accordons de l'importance avant tout aux principes fondamentaux de l'ingénierie, à la rapidité d'apprentissage, à la curiosité et à votre façon de penser. Les cours, les stages, la recherche et les projets personnels sont tous pris en compte.

Les compétences ou expériences pertinentes peuvent inclure :

La programmation en Python, C#, C++, Java ou des langages similaires.
Des systèmes de communication en temps réel utilisant WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, le streaming média ou le transport audio à faible latence.
Une expérience avec les systèmes DevOps, d'automatisation et de CI/CD à l'aide d'outils tels que TeamCity, Jenkins, GitHub, Artifactory.
Des projets impliquant des agents d'IA, des pipelines d'IA ou des systèmes RAG.
Une aisance avec le scripting sous Linux et Windows, ainsi qu'avec la virtualisation.
L'infrastructure de téléphonie et de voix, y compris le réseau téléphonique public commuté (RTPC/PSTN), le trunking SIP, le PBX et le routage des appels.

Vous n'avez pas besoin d'avoir de l'expérience dans tous ces domaines. La plupart des candidats retenus en maîtriseront quelques-uns et auront la curiosité d'apprendre le reste.

Fourchette de salaire de base cible : $70,000 - $90,000 CAD

jobs.title: Junior Developer (Finance Systems)
jobs.description:
**Harbor** is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented **Junior Developer** to join our financial systems consulting practice. This role is ideal for an early\-career professional looking to build experience in software development, systems integration, and legal technology solutions.



The Junior Developer will work alongside senior developers, consultants, project managers, business analysts, and client stakeholders to support the development, customization, integration, and maintenance of financial and practice management solutions for law firm clients, with a primary focus on Elite 3E and related legal technology platforms.



The successful candidate will have an eagerness to learn, strong problem\-solving skills, and a desire to build technical expertise while contributing to client projects. This role provides hands\-on experience with software development, database technologies, integrations, and consulting practices within a collaborative team environment.



#### **Job Duties and Responsibilities:**


**Solution Development \& Support**


* Assist with the development, customization, testing, and support of solutions within Elite 3E and related platforms.
* Support the creation and maintenance of workflows, business processes, interfaces, and automation solutions.
* Write, test, and troubleshoot code under the guidance of senior developers.
* Participate in debugging and issue resolution activities.
* Assist with application deployments and software updates.


**Systems Integration**


* Assist in developing and supporting integrations between financial systems and third\-party applications.
* Learn and work with REST APIs, data exchange technologies, and integration tools.
* Support data transformation and data exchange processes using XML, JSON, and related technologies.
* Help troubleshoot integration issues and support ongoing maintenance activities.


**Consulting \& Client Engagement**


* Participate in project meetings and requirements\-gathering sessions.
* Assist with documenting technical requirements, designs, and implementation activities.
* Collaborate with internal teams and client stakeholders to deliver project objectives.
* Provide timely updates on assigned tasks and project activities.


**Technical Operations \& Quality Assurance**


* Follow established development standards, processes, and best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior team members.
* Use Git or similar source control tools for managing code changes.
* Assist with software testing and quality assurance activities.
* Continuously develop technical and consulting skills through training and hands\-on project experience.


**Education, Experience, and Other Requirements:**


**Education**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Equivalent education, internships, or relevant technical training will be considered.


**Experience**


* 0\-2 years of software development experience.
* Internship, co\-op, academic project, or entry\-level experience in software development is desirable.
* Exposure to Microsoft development technologies or object\-oriented programming concepts preferred.
* Familiarity with APIs, web services, or integration concepts is a plus.
* Experience working in a team environment and willingness to learn new technologies.


**Technical Skills:**



Preferred Knowledge:


* C\# or other object\-oriented programming languages
* .NET framework or .NET Core
* REST APIs
* JSON
* XML
* Git or other version control tools
* Power Automate


Nice to Have:


* Exposure to Elite 3E or legal technology platforms
* Basic reporting tools
* Cloud technologies
* Software testing methodologies


**Other Requirements**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Professional attitude and willingness to work directly with clients when needed.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Occasional travel may be required.


Success in this role means developing strong technical skills, contributing to client projects, learning industry\-leading financial and legal technology platforms, and growing into a trusted developer within the consulting practice. The ideal candidate is curious, coachable, accountable, and eager to build a long\-term career in software development and consulting.

 **About Us:**



Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900\+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.


*Harbor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, age, parental status, disabled status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification, in accordance with applicable law.*

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Apply:** Geologic Career Centre

 **Geologic** is a trusted data, software, and information solutions company committed to the Energy Industry. Everyday we provide global customers with market\-leading data, software, platforms, analytics, education, news, and insights that enable them to make vital decisions that drive growth and efficiency. Based in Calgary, with offices in London (UK) and Houston (US), we deliver critical data\-driven intelligence ranging from surface and subsurface well/asset level information \& insights to corporate performance benchmarking data and A\&D transaction data.


People make us successful. We're driven by a team of individuals whose unique backgrounds and experience allow us to provide the best products and customer service on the market. Together we're transforming the energy intelligence landscape.

 **The Role**

  

We're building a new cloud\-first product, designed from the ground up on modern technology with AI at its core, and we're looking for a **Junior Software Developer** to grow with it. You don't need years of industry experience. You do need solid fundamentals, real curiosity, and evidence that you enjoy solving hard problems, whether that comes from your degree, co\-op or internship terms, personal projects, or open source.


You'll join a small software development team building something new, working alongside senior software developers who will pair with you, review your code, and help you get good quickly.

 **How will you spend your day?**


You'll write and ship real code from early on, starting with well\-scoped pieces of the product and taking on more as you find your feet. You'll work on our cloud\-first product on AWS and get hands\-on exposure to modern AI and agentic approaches as part of everyday development, not as a side project.


Your work will be reviewed, and you'll be expected to ask questions, take feedback well, and learn fast. Over time you'll own features end to end and start contributing to how things are designed, not just how they're built.

 **Ready to apply? Here's what we're looking for:**

* Solid programming fundamentals and a genuine interest in writing good code
* A degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Evidence that you like solving problems: school or capstone projects, co\-op and internship work, personal projects, hackathons, open source, or similar
* Curiosity about cloud and AI, and enthusiasm to learn AWS and modern models on the job
* Clear communication, and the willingness to ask questions and act on feedback
* A collaborative attitude and eagerness to learn from more experienced software developers
* Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Python, SQL, REST APIs, and Git. Project or internship experience counts

  

Nice to haves:

* Exposure to a cloud platform, ideally AWS
* Any hands\-on experimentation with LLMs, AI tooling or agent frameworks, however informal
* Familiarity with version control, testing and code review in a team setting
* An interest in the energy sector, geospatial, or large\-scale data
